rules: one id, many zones: each zone entry carries its own level range and weight; no per-region copies
recorded entries = existing tables as they are; planned entries are guesses (guess:true)
art = registered in SPECIES (src/ui/data.js: hand-written 16 + synced sprite sets)
min_level = DEX evolution level (evolved forms never roll below it)
no lore text here: names/types/zones come from DEX_450
